{{Otheruses|Bantu}}
{{Quote|<nowiki />''[Ebenn Q3 Baobab]'' began his new life as a cabin boy on a Baobab caravel. Writing daily in his life journal, EQ3 wrestled with innate melancholia by musing on the rainbow sunsets of Bantu, the skies of Roon darkened by great mynock migrations, and the innocent and joyful babble of baby Rodians in the Kibanyas on Tatooine.|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide''|<ref name="PhraseBook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>}}
[[File:EbennBurtt-TPM.jpg|thumb|right|200px|During his childhood, the author Ebenn Q3 Baobab mused on the rainbow sunsets of Bantu.]]
The '''rainbow sunsets of Bantu''' were a weather phenomenon<ref name="PhraseBook" /> that originated<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the rainbow [[Star/Legends|sunsets]] of Bantu|system=[[Bantu system/Legends|Bantu system]]|legends=1}}</ref> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Bantu system/Legends|Bantu system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> As described by the publisher in the [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] edition of the [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab's]] [[Book/Legends|book]] the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'', the ten-[[Standard year/Legends|years]]-old Baobab began his travels across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="PhraseBook" /> at some point by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="32 BBY">{{Film|I}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], features an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]] {{CSWECite|I|59|Baobab, Ebenn Q3 (EQ3)}} identifies as [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]].</ref> as a cabin [[Gender/Legends|boy]] aboard a [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]] [[caravel]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Baobab kept a [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab's life journal|life journal]] in which he wrote [[Standard day/Legends|daily]], and one of the subjects covered in the journal was Baobab's musings on the rainbow [[Star/Legends|sunsets]] of Bantu, which involved him dealing with feelings of melancholia.<ref name="PhraseBook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rainbow sunsets of Bantu were introduced in the [[2001]] book [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], authored by [[Ben Burtt]].<ref name="PhraseBook" />
